hero-role: Surveying & Cartographic Engineer · Founder of Territorial · Technologist at IBGE
home-text-1: I'm a surveying and cartographic engineer who builds geospatial software. Through Territorial, the engineering consultancy I founded, I lead a team of developers delivering production platforms for companies whose work depends on spatial data: processing pipelines, backend orchestration, and the web, desktop and mobile clients on top of them. My role in each engagement spans architecture and development, consulting and technical leadership.
home-text-2: I also work at IBGE, Brazil's national statistics and mapping institute, as a Geographic and Statistical Information Technologist.
home-text-3: I hold a degree in Surveying and Cartographic Engineering and a master's in Civil Engineering focused on spatial databases and GIS, both from the Universidade Federal de Viçosa, and I've published on cadastral data modelling, PostGIS-based land registries and UAV-based structural monitoring. Before Territorial, I led cadastral projects and GIS product development at engineering companies in Brazil.
home-text-4: Most of what I build now runs on infrastructure I also wrote: Ordo for orchestration, Sentinel for monitoring, and the tooling that runs Territorial itself. New engagements go through Territorial.
capabilities-intro: Four areas I work across on every platform, from the data model to the deploy.
cap-geo-body: Spatial databases and cadastral data models, and the processing pipelines that turn imagery, LiDAR and bathymetry into products people can open in a browser.
cap-backend-body: APIs and job orchestration for long-running processing: validated contracts between steps, queues, artifacts and state you can query when something goes wrong.
cap-clients-body: Map-centric interfaces that non-GIS users can operate, from operations dashboards and 3D viewers to offline field apps.
cap-infra-body: Deployment, monitoring and documentation for platforms that have to stay up: containers, Kubernetes, edge delivery and synthetic tests that catch stale data before a client does.
projects-intro: Client platforms, Territorial products and the tools I built to run my own practice. Each page has a short summary for fast readers and a longer account of the engineering.
blog-intro: Surveying, GIS, spatial databases and the software around them — what I learn while building it.
blog-cta-text: If this was useful, take a look at the platforms I've built or get in touch about a project.
contact-text: For projects and consulting, reach me through Territorial or by email.
